## What each command proves

<!-- agent-engineering:judgment:commands-meaning:start -->
**Run everything from the repository root.** The two `evals/fixture` scripts in the table above belong to the *test subject*, not to this repo — never run them as gates.

| Command | What it actually proves | Fails on |
|---|---|---|
| `npm test` | The full suite: eleven checks in order, first non-zero exit aborts. OBSERVED `scripts/test-all.mjs:19` | any child exit not equal to 0 |
| `npm run validate` | `validate-forge.mjs` alone — routing data integrity, plus the ordering surface: every phase a role is gated to is reachable, section ownership agrees with role gating, no role owns two sections, every stage skill writes its role's section | a detectable domain nothing handles, or two orderings that disagree |
| `npm run test:install` | Installs the kit for all eight `AGENT_ID`s and asserts the layout. **Not part of `npm test`** | a missing skill file or lock entry |
| `npm run eval` | Layer B depth eval; needs a model-driven Forge run against a prepared fixture | nothing automatically — the verdict is human |
| `node skills/ae-forge/scripts/forge.mjs contract` | Prints the four ordering tables as JSON. Read-only; this is what `validate` checks | — |
| `node skills/ae-forge/scripts/forge.mjs runs` | Folds every recorded run: per-role selected/contributed/found counts and find rate, skip counts, lens usage, repair-cycle distribution, unassessed-risk count | — |

The eleven checks `npm test` runs, in order: `validate-suite.sh`, `validate-forge.mjs`, `test-forge.mjs`, `test-lens-selection.mjs`, `test-evals.mjs`, `test-contract.mjs`, `test-guard.mjs`, `test-packaging.mjs`, `test-docs-consistency.mjs`, `test-scaffold.sh`, `test-artifacts.sh`, plus `verify-citations.mjs` when `.dev/knowledge` exists. OBSERVED `scripts/test-all.mjs:19`.

Two of those are new and each closes a specific hole:

- **`test-contract.mjs`** runs the real analyzer over a constructed two-component project and asserts that every field a consumer reads is present *and populated*, that a foreign `analysis.schema` is reported rather than swallowed, that no rendered manifest or component row says `UNKNOWN`, and that a route written only in a comment is not detected. OBSERVED `scripts/test-contract.mjs:1`.
- **`test-guard.mjs`** asserts the enforcement tier refuses the two things it claims and **fails open** on a corrupt record, garbage stdin, empty stdin and an unknown mode. OBSERVED `scripts/test-guard.mjs:1`.

**No clean-test form is required** — every check spawns a fresh process and nothing caches. INFERRED from the plain `spawnSync` loop at `scripts/test-all.mjs:50`.

**Environment: none.** No check reads an environment variable. INFERRED: no `env` is passed at `scripts/test-all.mjs:51`.

**Prerequisite on Windows: Git Bash.** Four checks are shell scripts; the runner probes three absolute paths and falls back to bare `bash`, which on Windows would otherwise reach the WSL shim. OBSERVED `scripts/test-all.mjs:6`.

### CI

`.github/workflows/ci.yml:1` runs `npm test` on Ubuntu **and Windows** — both, because four checks are shell scripts and the Windows Git Bash resolution path is only exercised if Windows actually runs. `npm run test:install` is a separate job because it reaches the network and must not be able to fail the suite for an unrelated reason. No `npm ci` step: the suite is dependency-free, so it would be decoration.

### What is still NOT covered

- **`test-installer.mjs` installs from the local working tree**, OBSERVED `scripts/test-installer.mjs:31`, so it validates the installed *layout* and cannot detect that a skill directory is uncommitted and would therefore be absent from a GitHub install. Staging with `git archive HEAD` would close it.
- **No failing-test-first evidence.** `acceptance` for `bug` requires re-running the original reproduction but not that it existed and failed before the fix; `feature` carries `requires: []`. Only `refactor` has a mechanical check.
- **Checks are not component-scoped.** `analyze.mjs` records a `cwd` per command entry, but `audit` and `verify` do not filter "the project's relevant checks" by the components a diff touched.
